statements.t: Management expects digital assets to remain a significant component of our long-term capital allocation framework.

Unrealized gains and losses from changes in the fair value of digital assets are recognized in earnings in the period in which they occur, and realized gains and losses on disposals are presented separately as “Realized losses on digital assets.” Because the DAT is not primarily intended to serve as a revenue-generating activity, changes in fair value represent a key driver of period-over-period volatility in our…

Based on current assumptions and our existing near-cash liquidity of approximately $126.7 million, our other digital asset and strategic equity investment holdings, our continued access to capital through our ATM program, and our currently anticipated operating cash use of approximately $1.4 million per month, we believe our liquidity resources are sufficient to support both our operating business and Digital…
Based on current AUM levels, we expect cash consulting fees of approximately $4.0 million over the next 12 months.

Based on current borrowing levels and interest rates ranging from 12% to 18%, we expect interest expense under our lines of credit of approximately $0.8 million to $1.3 million over the next 12 months.

We estimate expected credit losses on accounts receivable and loans held-for-investment based on the financial condition of the counterparty, historical payment behavior, the value of any collateral, and current conditions.
In evaluating the need for a valuation allowance, we consider our history of losses, the expected timing of reversal of temporary differences, and projections of future taxable income.
